name: ANSI/IEEE resistor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for resistor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The fixed-resistor form identifies resistance in the circuit path. This original zigzag illustration explains the resistive function without assigning a standard graphic number; the component value, power rating and reference designator remain essential to reading the actual schematic.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read resistance and rating from the annotation rather than from the number of drawn zigzag segments.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A fixed resistance and a variable resistance are different component functions, even if their basic graphical family is related.
